items.description: A flaw in OpenSSH lets remote attackers sign in to certain Alpine Linux accounts without knowing a valid password or holding an SSH key. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-123158 and known as SSHole, affects unpatched servers that use the musl C library, run without Pluggable Authentication Modules (PAM), and allow SSH password logins. items.description: Cybercriminals posing as corporate IT support are calling employees and tricking them into handing over access to Microsoft 365 accounts, even when multifactor authentication (MFA) is enabled. The attackers have used compromised accounts to steal email and files from OneDrive and SharePoint, then contacted employees through Microsoft Teams or email to demand payment.
